rationale: Checked directly against both texts as shipped in this app, the call itself and the first response ("Come, follow Me... and I will make you fishers of men" / "at once they left their nets and followed Him") are worded identically in Matthew 4:19-20 and Mark 1:17-18. The label is strong rather than explicit because neither Gospel names or cites the other; the match rests on reading both texts directly. Real, checkable differences exist alongside the near-verbatim core: Matthew already calls Simon "Peter" (4:18) where Mark reserves that name for later (3:16); Matthew places the father in the net-mending scene (4:21) where Mark's parallel sentence does not; and Mark adds a detail absent from Matthew, that the brothers left their father "in the boat with the hired men" (1:20).
